title: Section D: Task Scheduler Verification
description: Validates cron/interval scheduling calculations, exponential backoff with jitter, distributed lease/lock expiration, and missed schedule catch-up policies.

assertions.name: Cron_And_Interval_Schedule_Calculation
assertions.message: Schedule interval intervals calculated with zero drift across 5 occurrences.

assertions.name: Exponential_Backoff_With_Jitter
assertions.message: Exponential backoff with full jitter tested across 5 retries (Bounded by 32.0s).

assertions.name: Distributed_Lock_Lease_Expiration
assertions.message: Distributed lease expired cleanly and reassigned to secondary worker without deadlock.

assertions.name: Missed_Schedule_CatchUp_Coalesce_Policy
assertions.message: Coalesced 3 missed schedule runs into single execution preventing queue deluge.
